visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting an interior scene with a fireplace, a bookshelf, and three figures. A woman sits in a chair on the left, looking toward a man seated on a bench in the center, who is being embraced by another woman standing behind him. A man in military-style uniform stands to the right. There is a framed portrait on the wall above the fireplace.
